hooks.name: Sync Theme CSS to Public
hooks.description: Automatically copies any CSS file saved in platform/themes/martfury/public/css/ to public/themes/martfury/css/ so the browser-served copy stays in sync with the source.

action.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const stdin=[];process.stdin.on('data',d=>stdin.push(d));process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const ctx=JSON.parse(stdin.join(''));const src=ctx.file||'';if(!src)process.exit(0);const filename=path.basename(src);const dst=src.replace('platform/themes/martfury/public/css/','public/themes/martfury/css/').replace('platform\\\\themes\\\\martfury\\\\public\\\\css\\\\','public\\\\themes\\\\martfury\\\\css\\\\');try{fs.copyFileSync(src,dst);console.log('Synced '+filename+' to public/themes/martfury/css/');}catch(e){console.error('Sync failed:',e.message);}});"
